newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firmer ahead of eurobond launch.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firmer ahead of eurobond launch.

text.p: MinFin bonds edged up in active trading ahead of Thursday's launch of Russia's second Eurobond with a volume of at least 1.5 billion marks and a maturity of seven years, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Prices are going up slowly as everybody is waiting for the Eurobonds," one dealer said.
Dealers said the third, fourth and sixth tranches were traded the most.
National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said Russian banks, which seemed long of paper, were seen selling.
"It is London who is mainly buying to take profits later on the Eurobond news," he added.
